source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: The National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1 provides detailed information on infant deaths, including demographic data and medical history. It includes variables such as sex, birth weight category, days lived, and prenatal care details but lacks specific measures for postconceptional age, maternal smoking during pregnancy, preterm birth status, breastfeeding at discharge, gestational age at birth, maternal infections in pregnancy, chronic intermittent hypoxia, and other physiological measurements relevant to the manuscript concepts.
